BOOKING INFORMATION

Plan first. Confirm with the owner.

This website helps you choose a trip, vehicle and hotel preference. It does not take payment or reserve a vehicle or room.

Three simple steps

  1. Choose your trip and vehicle. Add your date, pickup place, group size and accommodation preference.
  2. Open the WhatsApp draft, check the details, and send it when you are ready.
  3. Agree the arrangements, payment and booking confirmation directly with owner Hemanth Kumar.

Payment & confirmation

No payment is taken on this website. The owner handles payment instructions and confirms your booking directly on WhatsApp. Selecting a trip or vehicle is not a confirmed reservation.

Cancellations, refunds & date changes

Payment, booking confirmation, cancellations, refunds and date changes are handled directly with owner Hemanth Kumar on WhatsApp. Ask the owner to confirm the terms for your trip in writing before you pay.

The website does not promise a fixed refund amount, cancellation period or free date change.

Darshan tickets

We only guide you on how to book Tirumala darshan tickets. We do not book tickets for you. Darshan is subject to official availability.
